free_tier.stated: Sirius (jh-1c-1g-20gb-nvme) at USD 8.09/month, or USD 6.47/month when paid for 12 months (vendor tariff page 2026-11-07): 1 Intel core shared, 1,024 MB RAM, 20 GB NVMe, unmetered 300 Mbps port (fair-share, which the card equates to 93+ TB a month), IPv4 + IPv6, Tirana Albania. Billing terms run monthly to 36 months: the configurator's price table discounts 3 months 5%, 6 months 10%, 12 months 20% and 36 months 40% off the USD 8.09025 base, so the 12-month term totals USD 77.64. The configurator rendered its order form with no out-of-stock notice, so the plan is in stock; the order form posts to the site's own API behind a login/register step, and no guest cart page prices the plan. No renewal price is published. The IPv6-only Sirius variant is USD 6.02/month, or USD 4.81/month on 12 months; the tracker's USD 4.82/month row matches that variant's 12-month rate, not this plan's IPv4+IPv6 price. The vendor's plan page sells "Free unmetered traffic. You only pay for disk space. Every plan includes unlimited traffic." and prices the IPv4 separately at USD 3.31/month, with the free IPv6 address described as the budget path. The page title advertises "VPS from $1.99", which is the VPS Promo plan's first-month price; its terms read 'The "VPS Promo" plan is billed at a promotional price for the first month, then automatically switches to a suitable regular plan.'
